thread:
incidents-bot: PAGER: embeddings-reranker pipeline error-rate spike detected for batch endpoints (batch-rerank-v2). 5xx rate jumped to ~18% starting ~1809990600 UTC. Linked alerts: #alerts-embed, #alerts-rerank.
Marta K: I'm oncall — looking now. any customer pages?
Ayesha (oncall): Yes, Pager duty triggered for two customers complaining about degraded rerank results/timeouts. CS has one active ticket.
Kevin Li: I'm pulling infra logs for batch inference nodes (batch-rerank-v2). grabbing tail -n 500 from the last 2h.
Marta K: quick ask: is this only batch endpoints or streaming too?
Jamal R: from early checks it seems batch only. streaming/generation endpoints look stable.
Kevin Li: confirm — node metrics: CPU/GPU utilization normal, but lots of handler exceptions for vector size mismatch in downstream reranker. sample: 
```
ERROR Handler: downstream_reranker_unmarshal: expected vector_dim=768 got 512, shard_id=3, request_id=xx-yy
Trace: reranker_client.UnpackVectors -> validate_dims() -> raise DimMismatchError
```

Ayesha (oncall): That explains 5xxs. How many requests had wrong vector dim?
Kevin Li: preliminary grep shows ~12k requests in the 1h window reporting mismatch, across 7 batch jobs.
Marta K: timeline: when did batch image/regeneration code change? any deploys around 1809990000?
Kevin Li: There was a canary of embedder-quantize on 1809989800, and a config change on batch-scheduler around 1809990400.
Jamal R: hypothesis: embedder change produced 512-d vectors for some customers; reranker expects 768. Could be a model variant mismatch or quantization truncation.
Lina (product): Which customers impacted? any paying enterprise? need to prepare a customer note.
Ayesha (oncall): Affected customers: acme-corp (production), edu-platform (staging but hitting production batch), two smaller SaaS. acme opened a high P1.
Marta K: mitigation step — can we auto-failover batch-rerank-v2 to a compat reranker that accepts 512 dims?
Kevin Li: We have a compatible fallback endpoint rerank-compat-512 but it's not wired into the batch router. I can flip a routing rule to send requests with vector_dim=512 to rerank-compat-512.
Jamal R: do it, but add a short-lived metric filter so we can see success rate change. Also add a TTL for the rule so we don't leave it forever.
Ayesha (oncall): Kevin, please patch router now. I'll coordinate CS messaging.
Kevin Li: Applying rule: 
```
POST /router/rules
{ "match": "vector_dim==512", "route_to": "rerank-compat-512", "ttl": "2h" }
```
applied at 1809991400.
Marta K: after route change, 5xx rate dropped to ~2% within 3m. Customer errors halting.
Lina (product): Thanks — we'll prepare a status update: brief explanation and ETA for full fix.
Jamal R: root-cause investigation notes: need to collect full matrix: embedder model versions per batch job, quantization pipeline changes, batch-scheduler mapping of clients->model. Also check if any SDK changes (customer side) caused re-encoding.
Kevin Li: pulling model-version mapping: embedder instances show mixed versions: some on embedder-v3-768, some on embedder-v3-lite-512. Canary rollout logic should have been gated by tenant list; looks like scheduler mapping used a wrong feature flag set.
Marta K: concrete timeline bullets (draft):
- 1809989800: canary deploy embedder-v3-lite-512 to subset of nodes (intended internal only)
- 1809990200: incorrect scheduler config shipped that included external tenant mapping for batch jobs
- 1809990600: first customer 5xx observed (detection)
- 1809991400: mitigation — routing rule applied to rerank-compat-512
- 1809993000: continue monitoring, prepare RCA doc

Ayesha (oncall): Log artifacts uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1809991000/vector-shift/*.zip. Please add any parsed CSVs there.
Jamal R: hypothesis H1: scheduler config accidentally referenced the canary tag leading to mixing of embedder variants into customer batches. test: correlate batch_job_id -> embedder_instance_id -> model_tag.
Jamal R: hypothesis H2: quantization pipeline for embedder-v3-lite truncated vectors to 512 during serialization and didn't set metadata header. test: sample request payloads pre-router.
Kevin Li: ran queries, found batch_job 2234 used embedder instance with tag "v3-lite-canary". mapping table shows tenant_id field blank, fallback behavior used "any-available" which pulled the canary.
Marta K: action items (assign):
- Kevin Li: produce a join query tying batch_job -> instance -> model_tag and paste CSV to S3 (done by EOD)
- Jamal R: inspect serialization codepath for missing vector_dim header in v3-lite and open PR if necessary (ETA 3h)
- Ayesha: coordinate customer comms and update CS tickets with mitigation steps and ETA for full fix (in progress)
- Marta K: prepare RCA draft and timeline, include mitigations and long-term fixes (lockdown rollout scoping)

Kevin Li: uploaded mapping CSV: s3://redwood-incidents/1809991000/job-instance-mapping.csv. sample row: 
```
batch_job_id,tenant_id,instance_id,model_tag,vector_dim
2234,acme-corp,i-0a12,v3-lite-canary,512
2235,edu-platform,i-0b34,v3-768-stable,768
```
Jamal R: found serialization path where header "X-vec-dim" is conditionally set only for stable builds, v3-lite missed it because build flag absent. opened PR #4567 to add explicit header and fallback validation.
Marta K: customer impact assessment: acme-corp saw ~27% of their batch rerank jobs failing during window, intermittently causing wrong ranking and job failures. We should offer post-mortem and credits.
Lina (product): prepare draft customer note: explain cause (mis-routed canary embedder -> dimension mismatch), mitigation (router rule + fix), timeline, and next steps. I'll draft and share in #customer-communications.
Ayesha (oncall): transitioning to morning shift handoff at 1809994600. Please add any outstanding logs/outputs. I'll leave the routing TTL in place until PR validated and a proper rollout gating is reconfigured.
Kevin Li: next steps for infra: revert faulty scheduler config, add strict tenant scoping for canary tags, and add a warning if model_tag != expected_tag for tenant. I'll file infra ticket INF-789.
Jamal R: dev next steps: enforce vector_dim header for all embedder builds, add unit test, and update integration tests to assert reranker compatibility. PR #4567 -> needs review.
Marta K: I'll combine timeline, hypotheses, logs, and action items into initial RCA draft and open a docs PR: rca/embedder-rerank-vector-shift.md. Assigning reviewers: Kevin, Jamal, Ayesha.
Lina (product): thanks team. tagging execs in case they want a short summary in the morning.
incidents-bot: Incident status: mitigated (routing rule applied) — monitoring. Severity downgraded to Sev3.
Ayesha (oncall): Handoff: monitoring looks stable, 5xx < 1% last 15m. leaving a runbook note: check s3 bucket for mapping CSVs and PR status.
Marta K: I'll pick this back up for the formal RCA write-up. anyone else add anything now?
Kevin Li: added a note: verify that archive encoding process preserved vector payloads for some legacy jobs (s3://.../raw-requests/*.gz) — might help debug client-side influence.
Jamal R: tagging engineer who touched canary: @dev-tanmay for visibility.
Lina (product): End of thread for handoff. we'll update customers after dev confirms fix.
